scope: All components in packages/hx-library/src/components/ (~76 main + sub-components)

findings.description: formStateRestoreCallback has wrong signature: `state: string` instead of `state: string | File | FormData | null`. The browser can pass File or FormData types; failing to guard against them risks a runtime error.
findings.fix: Change signature to `formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | File | FormData | null, _mode: 'restore' | 'autocomplete'): void` and add a `typeof state === 'string'` guard before assigning.

findings.description: formStateRestoreCallback has wrong signature: `state: string` instead of `state: string | File | FormData | null`.
findings.fix: Change signature to `formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | File | FormData | null, _mode: 'restore' | 'autocomplete'): void` and add a type guard.

findings.description: formStateRestoreCallback has wrong signature: `state: string` instead of `state: string | File | FormData | null`.
findings.fix: Change signature to `formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | File | FormData | null, _mode: 'restore' | 'autocomplete'): void` and add a type guard.

findings.description: formStateRestoreCallback has wrong signature: `state: string`. Also, formResetCallback calls `setFormValue('')` instead of `setFormValue(null)` — empty string is submitted as a form value whereas null correctly removes the entry.
findings.fix: Update formStateRestoreCallback signature to include `string | File | FormData | null`. In formResetCallback, change `setFormValue('')` to `setFormValue(null)`.

findings.description: formStateRestoreCallback missing `null` in union type. Signature should include `string | File | FormData | null` per the HTML spec.
findings.fix: Add `| null` to the state parameter type in formStateRestoreCallback.

findings.description: Component is form-associated (static formAssociated = true) but missing formResetCallback and formStateRestoreCallback. Form resets and bfcache restores will not work.
findings.fix: Add `formResetCallback()` that resets value to default, and `formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | File | FormData | null)` that restores the value.

findings.description: Component is form-associated but missing formResetCallback and formStateRestoreCallback.
findings.fix: Add formResetCallback and formStateRestoreCallback methods, or remove form association if the component does not submit form data.

findings.description: Component is form-associated but missing formResetCallback and formStateRestoreCallback.
findings.fix: Add formResetCallback (reset value to 0) and formStateRestoreCallback (restore from string state).

findings.description: Uses `Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)` for panel ID generation. This is NOT SSR-safe — Math.random() produces different values on server vs client, causing hydration mismatches. All other components in the library use module-level counters.
findings.fix: Replace with a module-level counter pattern: `let _hxOverflowMenuIdCounter = 0;` and use `hx-overflow-menu-panel-${++_hxOverflowMenuIdCounter}`.

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector('[part~="button"]')` and `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector('[part~="panel"]')` instead of the `@query` decorator.
findings.fix: Replace with `@query('[part~="button"]') private _triggerButton` and `@query('[part~="panel"]') private _panel` decorators.

findings.description: The `updated()` method does not call `super.updated()`. While LitElement's base updated() is a no-op, omitting super is a latent bug — if a mixin or future base class adds behavior to updated(), it will be silently skipped.
findings.fix: Add `super.updated(changedProperties);` as the first line in the updated() method.

findings.description: The `updated()` method does not call `super.updated()`.
findings.fix: Add `super.updated(changedProperties);` as the first line.

findings.description: The `updated()` method does not call `super.updated()`. The method handles the `open` property change but omits the super call.
findings.fix: Add `super.updated(changedProperties);` as the first line.

findings.description: Floating promise from `this.updateComplete.then(...)` in _handleMobileToggle. The promise is not voided or caught, which can cause unhandled rejection warnings.
findings.fix: Prefix with `void this.updateComplete.then(...)` or use an async function with try/catch.

findings.description: Floating promise from `this.updateComplete.then(...).catch(...)` in _openMenu. While the catch prevents unhandled rejection, the pattern should use void or async/await for clarity.
findings.fix: Use `void this.updateComplete.then(...)` or convert _openMenu to async.

findings.description: Two instances of floating `updateComplete.then()` without `void` prefix (lines 196 and 227).
findings.fix: Add `void` prefix to both `this.updateComplete.then(...)` calls.

findings.description: Inline arrow functions in template: `@click=${() => this._handleOptionClick(slot)}` and `@mouseenter=${() => this._handleOptionMouseEnter(index)}` inside the repeat() callback. Creates new function allocations on every render cycle for every option.
findings.fix: Use event delegation on the listbox parent with data attributes to identify the clicked option, or accept the overhead as acceptable for a bounded set of time slots.

findings.description: Inline arrow functions in template bindings and inline style string interpolation. Creates new function allocations and bypasses the CSS-only styling convention.
findings.fix: Extract arrow functions to named methods. Replace inline style strings with classMap or CSS custom properties.

findings.description: Multiple inline arrow functions throughout the template (lines 318, 334, 363, 379, 395). Each creates a new function on every render.
findings.fix: Use event delegation with data attributes on the wrapper, or extract to bound methods.

findings.description: Inline arrow functions in template bindings for star rendering.
findings.fix: Use event delegation on the star container with data attributes.

findings.description: Inline arrow function in template for close button click handler.
findings.fix: Extract to a named private method.

findings.description: Inline arrow function in template for close button click handler.
findings.fix: Extract to a named private method.

findings.description: Inline arrow functions for stepper pointerdown handlers (lines 591, 605).
findings.fix: Extract to named bound methods.

findings.description: Inline style string construction via `_baseStyle()` method that builds a CSS string and applies it via `style=` attribute. This bypasses shadow DOM styling encapsulation.
findings.fix: Replace with CSS custom properties set via `styleMap()` or `:host` selectors that read properties.

findings.description: Inline style string via `_startPanelStyle()` method that returns a raw CSS string.
findings.fix: Use `styleMap()` directive or CSS custom properties.

findings.description: Inline style on live region span element.
findings.fix: Move the style to the component's styles file.

findings.description: Sets inline styles via `this._lightDomDescription.style.cssText` for the visually-hidden span. Also sets `Object.assign(tooltipEl.style, ...)` and `Object.assign(arrowEl.style, ...)` for positioning (lines 202, 216).
findings.fix: The visually-hidden inline style is acceptable for a light DOM element. The positioning styles from Floating UI are also acceptable as they must be dynamic. Low priority.

findings.description: Sets inline styles via `this.style` property in lifecycle hooks (lines 79, 95). The component uses Light DOM intentionally, but setting `this.style.maxWidth` directly on the host is an inline style pattern.
findings.fix: Use a CSS custom property and `:host` selector instead: set `--_max-width` and consume it in the stylesheet.

findings.description: Uses `key=${i}` in skeleton row rendering — this is a React-ism. In Lit, use the `repeat()` directive with a key function for keyed rendering, or omit keys entirely as Lit's default rendering handles index-based lists efficiently.
findings.fix: Remove `key=${i}` attributes from skeleton row templates.

findings.description: Slot tracking booleans (_hasLabelSlot, _hasErrorSlot, _hasPrefixSlot, _hasSuffixSlot, _hasHelpTextSlot) are plain `private` properties that call `this.requestUpdate()` manually instead of using `@state()`. This bypasses Lit's reactive system and can cause update timing issues.
findings.fix: Change all slot tracking booleans to use `@state()` decorator and remove the manual `this.requestUpdate()` calls.

findings.description: Sets ARIA attributes directly on the host element via `this.setAttribute()` in `willUpdate()` and `connectedCallback()` (lines 108-137). While this works, it mixes imperative host attribute mutation with Lit's declarative rendering.
findings.fix: Consider moving ARIA attributes to the template render method using Lit bindings, or document the intentional imperative approach.

findings.description: Sets ARIA attributes imperatively on the host element in connectedCallback (lines 68-70) and updated (lines 73-80). Uses `this.setAttribute('role', 'radio')`, `this.setAttribute('aria-checked', ...)` etc. This is a valid pattern for components that need ARIA on the host, but should be documented.
findings.fix: Consider using `@property({ reflect: true, attribute: 'role' })` or document the intentional imperative approach.

findings.description: Sets `role="tabpanel"` imperatively in connectedCallback. This is fine for host-level ARIA, but a static property or attribute default would be more declarative.
findings.fix: Minor — consider using `this.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel')` in the constructor or via a static initializer, or leave as-is since connectedCallback is the conventional pattern.

findings.description: Uses `.bind(this)` in connectedCallback for event listeners instead of arrow function class fields. The `.bind()` pattern creates a new function reference each time connectedCallback fires (e.g., if the element is moved in the DOM), which means `removeEventListener` in disconnectedCallback will not remove the original listener, causing memory leaks.
findings.fix: Replace `.bind(this)` with arrow function class fields (e.g., `private _handleX = (e: Event): void => { ... }`).

findings.description: Uses `@cssproperty` instead of `@cssprop` for all CSS custom property annotations (lines 40-50). `@cssproperty` is NOT a valid CEM JSDoc tag — the correct tag is `@cssprop`. These 11 CSS properties will be missing from the Custom Elements Manifest.
findings.fix: Replace all `@cssproperty` tags with `@cssprop`.

findings.description: Styles are defined inline via `css` tagged template in the component file instead of a separate `*.styles.ts` file. This violates the project's file structure convention and makes styles harder to maintain.
findings.fix: Extract styles to `hx-carousel-item.styles.ts` and import them.

findings.description: Uses `:focus` selector (line 37) in addition to `:focus-visible`. The project convention requires `:focus-visible` only, never `:focus`.
findings.fix: Remove the `.slide-group:focus` selector and keep only `.slide-group:focus-visible`.

findings.description: Uses string concatenation for CSS classes: `class="list-item ${this.selected ? 'list-item--selected' : ''} ${this.disabled ? 'list-item--disabled' : ''}"` in multiple render paths (lines 189, 220). Should use `classMap()` directive for consistency and correctness.
findings.fix: Replace string concatenation with `classMap()` directive in all render paths.

findings.description: Uses string concatenation for CSS classes: `class="children ${this.expanded ? 'children--expanded' : ''}"`. Should use `classMap()` directive.
findings.fix: Replace with `class=${classMap({ children: true, 'children--expanded': this.expanded })}`.

findings.description: The `orientation` and `size` properties are marked `@internal` but use `@property({ reflect: true })` which makes them part of the public attribute API. Internal properties that are set by the parent should use `@property({ attribute: false })` or `@state()` to avoid exposing them as public attributes.
findings.fix: Change `orientation` and `size` to use `attribute: false` since they are set programmatically by the parent hx-steps.

findings.description: Sets host attributes imperatively in connectedCallback (`role`, `tabindex`) and updated (`aria-current`, `aria-disabled`, `tabindex`). This mixes imperative host mutation with Lit's reactive system.
findings.fix: Group all host attribute mutations into a single private method called from updated(), or use a HostElement mixin pattern.

findings.description: The `_syncHostAria()` method sets ARIA attributes imperatively on the host element from within `updated()`. While functional, this creates a fragile coupling between the reactive system and imperative DOM manipulation.
findings.fix: Consider moving host ARIA to the constructor or connectedCallback for static attributes, or document the intentional pattern.

findings.description: Sets role attribute conditionally in connectedCallback based on parent context. This is a valid defensive pattern but will not react if the element is moved between parents without disconnection/reconnection.
findings.fix: Acceptable pattern — document that the role is only set on initial connection.

findings.description: The `_dispatchToggleEvent` method is not prefixed with underscore consistently — it lacks the `private` keyword while other internal methods use `private`. It's a package-internal method used by the parent accordion.
findings.fix: Add `private` modifier or document it as `@internal` if it needs to be called by the parent.

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector()` in multiple places (_setupTriggerAria line 118, _handleTriggerMouseleave line 244, _updatePosition lines 190-192) instead of `@query` decorators.
findings.fix: Replace querySelector calls with `@query` decorators where possible. Note: some usages query slot elements which are acceptable.

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.toast')` instead of `@query` decorator.
findings.fix: Replace with `@query('.toast') private _toastEl: HTMLElement | undefined;`

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector<HTMLSlotElement>('slot:not([name])')` in firstUpdated instead of `@query` decorator.
findings.fix: Replace with `@query('slot:not([name])') private _defaultSlot: HTMLSlotElement | undefined;`

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.menu-item')` in the focus() override instead of `@query` decorator.
findings.fix: Replace with `@query('.menu-item') private _menuItemEl: HTMLElement | undefined;` and reference it in focus().

findings.description: Uses `this.shadowRoot?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.item-row')` in focus() override instead of `@query` decorator.
findings.fix: Replace with `@query('.item-row') private _rowEl: HTMLElement | undefined;`

findings.description: Imports `css` from 'lit' and defines styles inline in the component file. The `css` import is not needed when styles are in a separate file.
findings.fix: Move styles to hx-carousel-item.styles.ts and remove the `css` import.

findings.description: The component does not dispatch any prefixed `hx-` custom events for expand/collapse or click actions. Parent hx-side-nav must directly manipulate child properties. This limits composability and event-driven architectures.
findings.fix: Consider adding `hx-nav-item-toggle` or `hx-nav-item-click` events for consistency with the library's event-driven pattern.

findings.description: Missing `@csspart` annotation. The component does not expose any CSS parts despite having a `.slide-group` wrapper element.
findings.fix: Add `part="slide"` to the `.slide-group` div and document with `@csspart slide - The slide wrapper element.`
